subject.title: [Bug]: Runtime tool surface returns blank body after gateway-touching operations; container restart only briefly clears it

question: Should maintainers treat the linked prompt tool-result PR as a candidate fix for this gateway/session wedge, or require a separate live-repro isolation before any repair work starts?
rationale: The issue has multiple strong user reproductions, but the currently linked code path is adjacent rather than proven to own the gateway-touching session-scoped failure.

options.title: Require live isolation first
options.body: Use the reported live sessions/logs to identify whether the stuck state is in session locks, gateway restart deferral, tool invocation serialization, or prompt truncation before authorizing a fix PR.

options.title: Try the linked PR as candidate
options.body: Evaluate `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524` against a reported wedged session and close or narrow this issue only if it demonstrably fixes the gateway-touching wedge.

options.title: Sponsor a recovery surface
options.body: Accept the product direction for a `sessions reset` or `tools_status` surface and scope it as a separate core recovery feature alongside the bug fix.

recommendation.title: Require live isolation first
recommendation.body: Use the reported live sessions/logs to identify whether the stuck state is in session locks, gateway restart deferral, tool invocation serialization, or prompt truncation before authorizing a fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest concrete source lead is the session-scoped lock path, and recent history ties that area to this owner signal.
